tools.name: list_objects
native_sources: kubectl get {resource} -o json with optional namespace and label selector
tools.audit_boundary: One Kubernetes resource kind and optional selector.

tools.name: list_events
native_sources: Kubernetes Events API through kubectl get events

tools.name: get_job_logs
tools.audit_boundary: Native stdout for one named Job.

tools.name: create_object
native_sources: kubectl create -f - using the explicit manifest
tools.audit_boundary: One native create request; generateName may allocate a new identity.

tools.name: apply_object
native_sources: kubectl apply -f - using the explicit manifest
tools.audit_boundary: One declarative write for one named object.

tools.name: patch_object
native_sources: kubectl patch with native merge, strategic or JSON patch
tools.audit_boundary: One named object and explicit patch body.

tools.name: remove_node_taint
tools.audit_boundary: One visible taint on one Node.

tools.name: wait_for_job
tools.audit_boundary: Native Job Complete condition with a bounded timeout.

tools.name: list_external_deliveries
native_sources: GET /deliveries on the open-source receiver ledger
tools.audit_boundary: Durable receiver keys and attempt counts.

tools.name: get_external_delivery
native_sources: GET /deliveries/{idempotency-key} on the open-source receiver ledger
tools.audit_boundary: One durable receiver record and its attempts.

tools.name: post_external_event
native_sources: POST /webhooks/events with the explicit X-Idempotency-Key and payload
tools.audit_boundary: One real receiver attempt; duplicate attempts remain auditable.
